newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rises for 3rd day, led by networking stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rises for 3rd day, led by networking stocks.

text.p: Nasdaq shares finished higher for the third consecutive session on Wednesday, as computer-networking stocks and other technology shares showed strength, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite gained 18.13 points, or 1.46 percent, to close unofficially at 1260.76. On a percentage basis, the gain was larger than the 0.67 percent increase in the Dow industrials, which closed at 7009, up nearly 47 points.
Computer-networking stocks continued to rally as the outlook for the sector brightened ahead of a major industry trade show next week in Las Vegas, analysts said.

"The small-cap stocks, at best, aren't going down. There was not much room for them to go down. Techs have come back a bit in the past few sessions," said Nelson Gold, senior vice president of over-the-counter trading at Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp.

Cisco Systems Inc's, the most active Nasdaq issue, gained 1-3/4 to 51-3/4, and Ascend Communications Inc added 4-5/16 to 45-3/4. Technology leaders such as Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp also rose. Advancing
Nasdaq issues beat decliners 2229 to 2049 on total volume of 667.3 million shares.
